meta.name: import-leads
meta.description: Import a batch of leads from CSV, JSON, or a Notion DB into the local SQLite database without running the qualification pipeline. Use when the user says 'just import this CSV', 'load these leads without qualifying', 'bulk import this file', 'add these prospects to the DB', or 'pull this Notion DB into YALC'. Side-effecting — writes rows into local SQLite.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量导入客户线索到本地数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从文件或Notion批量导入客户线索
copy.tagline_en: Import leads in batch to local database
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to bulk import leads from files or Notion

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你从 CSV、JSON 或 Notion 数据库批量导入客户线索到本地 SQLite 数据库，且不经过资格认定。它会先询问输入源和路径，然后执行导入并返回结果集 ID。
howto.when: 当你说“导入这个 CSV”、“不认定直接加载”或“批量导入此文件”等时触发。要求导入但不进行资格认定。

say.text: 帮我导入这个 CSV 文件，不进行资格认定。
say.note: Claude 会询问文件路径并导入。

say.text: 从 Notion 数据库导入客户线索。
say.note: 需要提供 Notion 数据库 ID。

say.text: 批量导入这个 JSON 文件到本地数据库。
say.note: Claude 会执行导入并返回结果集 ID。

howto.what_en: Claude can batch import leads from CSV, JSON, or Notion DB into local SQLite without qualification. It asks for source type and path, then runs import and returns a result set ID.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'just import this CSV', 'load these leads without qualifying', 'bulk import this file', 'add these prospects to the DB', or 'pull this Notion DB into YALC'. Not for qualification or scraping.

say_en.text: Import this CSV file without qualification.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the file path and proceed.

say_en.text: Pull leads from a Notion database.
Batch import this JSON file into the local DB.
say_en.note: Claude imports and returns the result set ID.
